_meta.note: Adam's CR re-rates from the hot-45 review (2026-10-12). Applied over the Foe Folio print by metrics.mjs (model) and build.mjs (display); FF letters banked on the TODO. 'was' preserves the print.

GEAR GOLEM#0.why: Stone-Golem-class body (18 HD, 229 effHP, AC 30) plus magic immunity; golem doctrine prices immunity upward.

HILL GIANT DIRE WEREBOAR#2.why: Template stack under-charged: Fort +20, DR 10/silver, ferocity, +29/104.5-avg iterative routine deletes a CR-11 PC per round.

VIVILOR#7.why: Free-roaming unique-but-average fiend (Adam): the menu offense rides a CR-13 body (253 effHP, AC 28, DR 15/magic); the servitor discount does not apply.

VIVILOR#8.why: As the 8th-level rung: CR-14 body (287 effHP, AC 31, DR 15/magic), free-roaming.

KRAKEN#0.why: Heaviest honest routine in its band (119 avg behind +28, grab-and-constrict); its aquatic terrain favors IT, so no counter-lane discount.

DIRE BAT#0.why: AC 20 / 55 effHP at CR 2 - the classic hot CR 2; cheap honesty, no lore at stake.

PUPPETEER#1.why: The Flesh Harrower's body alone outruns CR 2; the controller note carries the real doctrine.

ATHACH#0.why: The one that got away in batch 1: 173 effHP, three-armed ~55-avg poison routine - the classic maul behind a friendly '8'. Model 10.7.

VIVILOR#5.why: Ladder smoothing (Adam: 'smooth out the staircase as best-fit') - model 9.0; the family now climbs ...6, 9, 11, 13, 14.

VIVILOR#6.why: Ladder smoothing - model 10.5, rounded to keep the staircase even.

MONSTROUS SCORPION#6.why: The MD ruling (Phase D): 3 effectively-100% forcing attacks/rd (avg 19 vs DC 15+excess) flip an at-level fight from 100% win/0 dead to 44%/2.96 dead - +2 per the gaveled constant.

GARBAGE TOXYDERM#1.why: The MD ruling: 4 forcing attacks/rd (avg 28) kill 0.70 benchmark PCs per at-level encounter that killed none without MD - +2 per the constant (verbatim Menace Manual per Adam; E&E's own MD rule is what is being priced).

TOXIC SLUDGE#1.why: The MD ruling: 4 forcing attacks/rd (avg ~21), at-level 1.75 PCs dead / 50% HP toll - +2 per the constant.
